narrative.intro: Brookhaven Science Associates has $830M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Brookhaven Science Associates received 2 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $415M. Obligations are down 0.5% year over year. The Department of Energy is the dominant buyer, obligating $830M to Brookhaven Science Associates in FY2026 to date. The National Aeronautics and Space Administration obligated $16K. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) accounted for $830M of obligations. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) accounted for $16K. Annual obligations show a multi-year pattern: FY21 was $668M, FY22 was $951M, FY23 was $789M, FY24 was $797M, FY25 was $834M, and FY26 is $830M to date. Current-year totals are partial and reflect fiscal year to date activity. This summary focuses on the scale, agency concentration, and the primary NAICS markets supporting Brookhaven Science Associates' federal revenues.

sections.heading: How concentrated are Brookhaven Science Associates' federal obligations?
sections.body: The Department of Energy is the largest buyer, obligating $830M in FY2026 to date. The National Aeronautics and Space Administration obligated $16K. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) is the primary NAICS market with $830M. The second NAICS market shows $16K, indicating high concentration in one agency and one market.

sections.heading: How have Brookhaven Science Associates' obligations trended over recent fiscal years?
sections.body: Obligations rose from $668M in FY21 to $951M in FY22, then fell to $789M in FY23. Obligations were $797M in FY24, $834M in FY25, and are $830M in FY26 to date. The current fiscal year total is partial and reported on a year-to-date basis. Year-over-year change is down 0.5%.
